name: Kashmir Grand Tour Package
route: Gulmarg → Sonmarg → Srinagar → Pahalgam → Srinagar → Gurez Valley → Gurez → Tulail Valley → Gurez → Srinagar
description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Kashmir through this extended 11-day journey, designed to showcase both popular attractions and offbeat destinations like Gurez and Tulail Valley. From serene lakes and Mughal gardens to high-altitude valleys and untouched landscapes, this tour offers a perfect blend of nature, culture, and adventure.
highlights: Scenic stay in Srinagar with Houseboat experience
Excursion to Gulmarg with optional Gondola ride
Day trip to Sonmarg – the “Meadow of Gold”
Visit to Pahalgam including Aru Valley, Betaab Valley & Chandanwari
Offbeat adventure to Gurez Valley via Razdan Pass
Local sightseeing in Dawar village and Habba Khatoon Peak
Excursion to the remote Tulail Valley
Complimentary Shikara ride on Dal Lake
Srinagar → Gulmarg → Sonmarg → Pahalgam → Srinagar → Gurez → Tulail → Srinagar
Carry valid government ID proof for all travelers
Weather can vary significantly—pack warm clothing year-round
Some regions (like Gurez) may have limited connectivity
Road conditions in remote areas can be challenging
Follow local guidelines and respect environmental rules

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.desc: On arrival at Srinagar Airport meet our Representative, who will take you to the Hotel in Srinagar, Overnight Stay at hotel in Srinagar

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Early in the morning leave for Gulmarg. A town, a hill station, a popular skiing destination during winters. Gulmarg is famous because of its “Gulmarg Gondola,” one of the highest cable cars in the world (Direct Payment Basis). Overnight stay at the hotel in Srinagar

itinerary.title: Sonmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Today you embark on a full day excursion to the picturesque 'meadow of gold’ Sonamarg. The fast flowing Sindh River makes it popular for trout and masher fishing in summer. You can opt for a pony ride to one of the glaciers for some fun in snow and ice (by your own payment) Return to the Hotel in Srinagar in the evening and enjoy comfortable overnight stay. Note: The vehicle will drop and pick you up at Sonmarg car stand. To reach the glaciers, you can hire ponies by your own payment basis. Return to the Hotel in Srinagar in the evening and enjoy comfortable overnight stay

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.desc: After Breakfast ,Take a Tour of Pahalgam, Pahalgam Has Places Like Betab Valley, Aru Valley, Baisaran, Chandanwadi and more. Enjoy Your Dinner and Stay at hotel in Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.desc: After Breakfast Leave for Srinagar Local. Visit Mughal Gardens and Overnight Stay at the hotel/Houseboat in Srinagar

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gurez Valley
itinerary.desc: Begin your day with breakfast and get ready for the drive towards Gurez valley. Gurez valley is located in the Himalayas and you reach there through road from Bandipora via Razdan Top. The drive is nothing less than a spectacular experience and you will notice the beauty of nature at its best. Visit Razdon top located at an altitude of 11672 feet. It is famous for its medicinal plant. Razdan Pass is an adrenaline pumping road in India. From Razdan top you can view the snow- capped Harmukh Peak which is the highest mountain peak of Kashmir. On reaching Gurez, check in to your hotel for an overnight stay

itinerary.title: Gurez Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Start your day with morning breakfast and prepare yourself for local sightseeing of Gurez. You will be visiting a local town known as Dawar. It is famous as an archaeological site. Here you will get to see beautiful log wood houses. The local people of Dawar town are called “Dards”. They are very friendly, you can talk to them and explore more about their local lives. Later you visit the pyramid- shaped Habba Khatoon peak. The beautiful mountain peak is an important part of Kashmir’s history. It is named after famous Kashmiri poetess Habba Khatoon. Another attraction of this place is Habba Khatoon spring. Lucid water gushing out of the mountain range is crystal clear and has medicinal properties. After a fun filled day, head back to your hotel. Take the dinner and prepare for an overnight stay

itinerary.title: Tulail Valley Excursion
itinerary.desc: After having your breakfast, you will drive towards Tulail valley via Dawar. This valley is one of the remotest valleys of the region. On reaching the valley, take a foot walk around the place. Explore the beautiful natural beauty of the region. This place is nothing less than a dreamland. Just sit and relax around lush green meadows and enjoy the beauty of Mother Nature. Later in the evening drive back to Gurez valley for an overnight stay

itinerary.title: Gurez to Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Begin this day of your majestic Gurez valley package with breakfast and get ready for a drive towards Srinagar. On your way, visit the Izamrg village and capture the splendid green meadows on your camera. You can also choose to take a walk around the village to explore its charm. On arrival in Srinagar, check into the hotel, take your dinner and head for an overnight stay

itinerary.title: Srinagar Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: After Breakfast Leave for Srinagar Local. Visit Mughal Gardens and Overnight Stay at the hotel/Houseboat in Srinagar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Early in the morning After Breakfast Leave for Srinagar Airport to continue your journey with all the beautiful memories from the trip
